name: SYSTEM.md
summary: In the Pi coding agent, SYSTEM.md replaces the default system prompt and APPEND_SYSTEM.md adds to it. Each can live in the agent directory (~/.pi/agent/) or in a project's .pi/ folder; the project file wins and loads only after the project is trusted. AGENTS.md context files are still loaded separately.
facts: Project over global; same-name files are not combined
goodFor: Fully custom system prompts per project
watchOut: Replacing the default prompt can drop tool guidance
